route: A recording, not live generation. Each model was generated once: an OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-flare picture (1536x1024), then a Meshy meshy-t2.5 textured model (smart topology, 10,000 target faces, GLB). The diving helmet is the model of the first measured run; the other five were made through the /api/object handler.
grammar: Per object, for src/astral/grammar.ts (Thing). height: true height in metres. wide, deep: the model's width (x) and depth (z) against its height, measured from the GLB's bounds on 2026-11-16; re-measure when a model is replaced. surfaces: what it stands on. kinds: the kinds of place it belongs to (office, home, service; none: it belongs nowhere). era: a year. repeatable: whether EVA may stand several of it. height, surfaces, kinds, era and repeatable are proposals for the owner to change.
